```yaml
name: Mobile Release

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  build-and-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v2

    - name: Set up Ruby
      uses: ruby/setup-ruby@v1
      with:
        ruby-version: '3.0'

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: bundle install --jobs 4 --retry 3

    - name: Run migrations
      run: bin/rails db:migrate

    - name: Run model tests
      run: bin/rails test test/models/family_test.rb

    - name: Run controller and model tests
      run: bin/rails test test/models/family_test.rb test/controllers/onboardings_controller_test.rb

    - name: Run RuboCop
      run: bin/rubocop

    - name: Build assets
      run: bin/rails webpacker:compile

    - name: Deploy to staging
      if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
      run: |
        echo "//staging.example.com:9000/api/v1/gems?api_key=$STAGING_API_KEY" > ~/.gemrc
        gem push *.gem
```

This GitHub Actions workflow file `.github/workflows/mobile-release.yml` automates the build, test, and deployment process for the `we-promise/sure` repository when changes are pushed to the `main` branch. It sets up the necessary Ruby environment, installs dependencies, runs database migrations, executes model and controller/model tests, checks code style with RuboCop, compiles assets, and deploys gems to a staging environment if the push is made to the `main` branch.
